description: Dialogue templates for NPC interactions - tone-aware greetings, static pools, and dynamic world templates

hostile: Get out. We don't serve your kind here.
You have a lot of nerve showing your face in my tavern.
cold: What do you want? Make it quick.
A room costs extra for the likes of you.
guarded: Hmph. I suppose you'll want something to drink.
Welcome to {tavernName}. Try not to cause trouble.
neutral: Welcome to {tavernName}. What can I get you?
Ah, a traveler. Pull up a chair if you like.
warm: Welcome to {tavernName}! What can I get for you?
Good to see you, traveler! Pull up a chair and stay awhile.
Come in, come in! The fire's warm and the ale is cold!
affable: Ah, my favorite customer! Your usual spot is waiting!
Welcome back, friend! First drink's on the house tonight!
There you are! I saved the best cut of meat just for you.
devoted: The hero returns! Everyone, drinks are on me tonight!
Welcome home, friend! {tavernName} is your tavern as much as mine.
It's always a blessing when you walk through that door.

hostile: You again? I told you to stay away from my establishment.
Out. Now. Before I call the guard.
cold: What now? I've got better things to do than deal with you.
If you're looking for sympathy, you won't find it here.
guarded: What do you want? Can't you see I'm busy?
Another adventurer, eh? Just don't cause any trouble.
neutral: Hmph. I suppose you'll want a room and some food.
The sign says 'open', doesn't it? What are you waiting for?
warm: Ah, it's you. Well, you're not the worst customer I've had.
Back again? I suppose you're alright. Sit down, then.
affable: Well if it isn't my most reliable patron! *almost smiles*
You're back! Don't tell anyone, but I saved you the good ale.
devoted: I... well, it's good to see you. Don't let it go to your head.
There's the one person who managed to earn my respect. Welcome.

hostile: The stars warned me you'd return. They also warned me to lock the door.
Some presences darken a room. Yours is one such presence.
cold: Hmm. The cards did not speak favorably of this meeting.
You carry a heavy aura, stranger. Mind it doesn't affect my patrons.
guarded: Welcome, traveler. I've been expecting someone like you...
Interesting timing, your arrival. Very interesting indeed.
neutral: Ah, you've arrived. Some might say it's fate.
Welcome to {tavernName}. I have a feeling we'll be seeing more of each other.
warm: The tea leaves foretold a friend's arrival. Here you are.
Welcome. Your presence brightens the shadows in this old place.
affable: I knew you'd come tonight. I've already poured your drink.
The wind whispered your name before you entered. Welcome, dear friend.
devoted: Fate itself smiles when you walk through these doors.
I have seen many futures, and in all the brightest ones, you stand at the center.

hostile: Don't come near me. I know what you've done.
You've got some nerve showing up here after what happened.
cold: Oh. It's you. I was having a perfectly good evening.
I'd rather drink alone, if you don't mind.
guarded: Hello. Forgive me if I'm not feeling sociable tonight.
I've heard your name around. Not sure what to make of it.
neutral: Hey there! Come join me for a drink!
Well met, friend! Always good to see a new face around here.
warm: Pull up a stool! I'll buy you a round.
Welcome! Are you passing through, or staying a while?
Good to see you! Come sit, I've been hoping for some company.
affable: There's my favorite adventurer! Let me get you a drink!
Everyone, this one's alright! Gather round, they have the best stories.
devoted: The legend walks among us! Please, sit with us! We insist!
I tell everyone about you, you know. You've changed this place for the better.

hostile: Get lost before I lose my temper.
I've got nothing to say to you. Nothing good, anyway.
cold: What are you staring at?
New in town? Great. Just what we need.
guarded: Don't bother me unless you're buying.
*grunts and looks away*
neutral: Hmph. You can sit there if you want. Just be quiet about it.
If you're looking for conversation, you've picked the wrong person.
warm: Alright, you can stay. You're less annoying than most.
Hmph. Fine. Sit down. Just don't talk my ear off.
affable: I don't like many people, but you... you're tolerable.
Bah, you're here. Fine. I suppose I'll let you buy me a drink.
devoted: If everyone were like you, this world wouldn't be half bad.
I don't say this to many people, but... I'm glad you're here.

hostile: Ha! Look who it is! The one who ruined everything! Ha ha... no, seriously, leave.
Oh wonderful, you're here. My evening is officially ruined.
cold: Well, well. I'd offer you a drink, but my generosity has its limits.
Ha. You. I suppose you think that's funny.
guarded: Ha ha! Another adventurer! Pardon me if I don't get too excited.
Welcome, welcome. I've learned to be careful who I drink with.
neutral: Well hello there! *slaps you on the back* You look like you have stories to tell!
A new face! The more the merrier, I always say!
warm: *laughs heartily* Welcome, friend! The night is young!
Ha ha! There you are! I've been saving a seat! Come, drink!
affable: Everyone! The best drinking companion in the realm has arrived!
HA HA! My friend returns! Quick, break out the good stuff!
devoted: THE HERO RETURNS! *lifts you off your feet in a bear hug*
Everyone raise a glass! To the greatest soul I've ever known!

hostile: P-please don't hurt me! I'll leave, I'll leave!
*cowers* I know you're angry... please, I'm sorry!
cold: Oh! Um... I'll just... be over here...
*avoids eye contact* Sorry, sorry...
guarded: Oh! Um, hello... you're not here to cause trouble, are you?
*glances around nervously* Oh, hi... sorry, I thought you were someone else.
neutral: *fidgets* H-hello, stranger...
Oh, um. Hi. Don't mind me, I'm just... sitting here.
warm: Oh! It's you! I was hoping you'd come by. You make me feel safer.
H-hi! I saved you a seat! I mean, if you want it...
affable: You're here! Oh good, I always feel braver when you're around.
*brightens up* Oh, thank goodness it's you! Sit, please!
devoted: I don't feel scared anymore when you're around. Thank you for that.
You're the reason I started coming out again. You gave me hope.

hostile: Store's closed. For you, permanently.
You can take your coin elsewhere. I don't deal with the likes of you.
cold: If you must buy something, make it quick.
Prices go up for those I don't trust. Fair warning.
guarded: Welcome to {shopName}. I'll be keeping my eye on you.
You can look, but don't touch anything unless you're buying.
neutral: Welcome to {shopName}! How can I help you today?
Good day! Looking for supplies? You've come to the right place!
warm: Ah, a customer! Please, browse my wares. I have the finest goods in {settlement}!
Welcome, welcome! Everything you need and more, right here!
affable: My favorite customer! I set aside some special stock just for you!
Welcome back! Let me show you what just came in — first pick, just for you.
devoted: Anything in the shop is yours at my best price. You've earned that and more.
For you? I'd sell at cost. You've done more for this town than anyone.

hostile: Your gold's no good here. Get out before I call the guard.
I'd sooner burn my stock than sell to you.
cold: Ah, a customer! Ready to spend some gold, I hope? Double for you.
You want my goods? It'll cost you. More than most.
guarded: Welcome! I have many fine items... for the right price.
Yes, yes, what do you want to buy? I don't give refunds, mind you.
neutral: Looking to purchase? Good, good. I have rent to pay, you know.
Ah, browse away! But mind the prices — quality costs coin.
warm: A valued customer! Perhaps today I can interest you in something premium?
Welcome! Business is good when you're around. Let's make a deal!
affable: Ah, my golden goose returns! I mean, my esteemed friend! Special prices today!
For you, a special discount! Well, a small one. Business is business.
devoted: Name your price, friend. After everything you've done, I owe you.
You've made me a wealthy merchant. The least I can do is share the fortune.

hostile: Leave. Now. I won't ask twice.
My shop, my rules. And the first rule is you're not welcome.
cold: State your business. Quickly.
I run an honest shop. Whether you deserve to shop here is another matter.
guarded: Welcome. State your business.
I run an honest shop here. No haggling, no stealing. Understood?
neutral: Yes? Do you need something, or are you just browsing?
I have quality goods at fair prices. What do you need?
warm: Ah, you again. You've proven yourself reliable. Welcome.
Good day. I've got what you need, as always.
affable: You are one of the few customers I actually look forward to seeing.
I've been saving something special for someone I trust. That's you.
devoted: I would trust you with my life savings. You are the most honorable person I know.
You have my unwavering respect. Whatever you need, it's yours.

hostile: I won't forge a single nail for you. Leave my smithy.
The fire burns for honest folk. Not for the likes of you.
cold: I'll do the work, but don't expect me to enjoy your company.
Need something fixed? Fine. But make it quick.
guarded: Welcome. Looking for quality steel? I've got standards, mind you.
Need a weapon? I forge good ones. Whether you deserve it is your business.
neutral: Ah, welcome to the forge! Looking for quality steel?
Good day! Need a blade sharpened, or perhaps new armor?
warm: Well met! I've just finished a fine set of weapons. Care to take a look?
Welcome! Best smithwork in the region, if I do say so myself!
affable: Perfect timing! I've been working on something special with you in mind!
My best customer! Come see what the fire and anvil have birthed today!
devoted: Every blade I forge, I think of you on the front lines. Let me make sure you're protected.
For the defender of our people — I've put my heart and soul into this piece.

hostile: Out. I don't shoe horses for you, let alone forge weapons.
This hammer works for me. And it can work against you. Leave.
cold: What do you want? I'm in the middle of something. Something important.
Make it quick. I've got orders for people I actually like.
guarded: Make it quick. I've got orders to fill.
Another adventurer needing gear, I suppose. *sighs*
neutral: Yes? I don't have all day.
Need something? I've got work to do.
warm: Oh, it's you. *nods* You're one of the few I don't mind interrupting me.
Back again? Alright, alright. Let me see what you've broken this time.
affable: Ha! You're back! I'll admit, your business keeps the forge burning bright.
I don't smile for just anyone, but... *grunts approvingly* Good to see you.
devoted: I may be grumpy, but I'll always make time for you. Always.
You know what? You're the reason I still believe in people. Don't tell anyone.

hostile: My masterwork is wasted on unworthy hands. Begone.
I forge for heroes, not villains. The door is behind you.
cold: I forge for those who deserve quality. The jury is still out on you.
Touch anything and you'll answer to me. These are works of art.
guarded: Welcome to the finest forge in all the land. Mind your manners.
You may browse, but handle nothing without permission.
neutral: Ah! You have a good eye for quality, I can tell. You've come to the right place.
Every piece I make is a work of art. You won't find better.
warm: Welcome! I am the master of my craft. What can I forge for you?
A discerning customer! I appreciate those who value true craftsmanship.
affable: Ah, the warrior who knows quality! I've been perfecting something extraordinary for you.
You are one of the few worthy of my finest work. Come, let me show you.
devoted: To forge for you is the greatest honor of my career. I give you my absolute best.
When legends speak of your deeds, they'll mention the weapons I made for you.

hostile: You are no longer welcome in {settlement}. Leave before I summon the guard.
Your actions have brought shame upon you. I have nothing to say.
cold: Greetings. I must be direct — your reputation here is... complicated.
I will hear you out, but do not expect warmth.
guarded: Greetings, traveler. I trust you bring no trouble to {settlement}.
Welcome. I am cautious by nature, so you'll forgive my reserve.
neutral: Greetings, traveler. Welcome to {settlement}.
Ah, a visitor. What brings you to our humble settlement?
warm: Welcome. I am {name}, {title} of {settlement}. How may I assist you?
Greetings. It's rare we see adventurers these days. What news from the road?
affable: My friend! {settlement} prospers in part because of you. What brings you today?
Ah, a welcome sight indeed! Please, join me. We have much to discuss.
devoted: The people's champion returns! All of {settlement} celebrates your arrival.
If I could name you co-ruler of {settlement}, I would. You have earned our eternal gratitude.

hostile: Guards! Remove this person from my hall at once.
I warned you. There will be consequences for your actions.
cold: State your business, traveler. My patience is thin where you're concerned.
I have little time and less trust for you. Speak quickly.
guarded: State your business, traveler.
I am {name}, {title} of {settlement}. What do you want?
neutral: We don't take kindly to troublemakers here. I trust you'll behave yourself?
Welcome to {settlement}. Obey our laws and we'll have no problems.
warm: You've proven yourself in {settlement}. You have my respect.
Good. You're here. I have matters that require someone I can rely on.
affable: You have earned my trust — a rare achievement. Welcome, friend.
I don't say this lightly: you are one of the finest people I've met.
devoted: I would follow you into battle myself, if my duties here allowed it.
You are the standard to which I hold all others. {settlement} is honored.

hostile: Honor demands I give you a chance to speak, but my patience is spent.
You have dishonored yourself in the eyes of {settlement}. Begone.
cold: I am bound by duty to hear you, though my heart tells me otherwise.
Come. But know that trust, once broken, is hard to mend.
guarded: Greetings. I judge people by their deeds. Yours have been... mixed.
Welcome to {settlement}. I hope your next actions speak better than your last.
neutral: Welcome, brave traveler. {settlement} is honored by your visit.
Well met! I am {name}, {title} of this settlement. You are among friends here.
warm: Greetings. Your reputation precedes you, adventurer.
Welcome to {settlement}. How may I be of service to such a valiant soul?
affable: The defender of the people! Your name is spoken with reverence here.
It brings me great joy to welcome you again. {settlement} is stronger for your friendship.
devoted: You embody everything I strive to be. {settlement} would not stand without you.
If there is a more honorable soul in all the land, I have not met them.

hostile: Halt! You're not welcome here. Turn around and keep walking.
I have orders to watch you. One wrong step and it's the dungeon.
cold: Keep your distance. I've heard things about you.
Move along. And stay out of trouble.
guarded: Ho there. Keep your weapons sheathed and we won't have problems.
I've got my eye on you, traveler.
neutral: Ho there! Welcome to {settlement}. Try not to cause any trouble, eh?
Good day! Keeping the peace around here. Let me know if you need anything.
warm: Well met, traveler! {settlement} is a safe place, thanks to us guards!
Welcome! Don't worry, we keep the riff-raff out of {settlement}.
affable: It's always a relief when you're in town. Extra sword arm, you know?
Good to see you, friend! The watch is easier when allies are around.
devoted: I'd gladly fight beside you any day. You're one of us now.
The guard stands taller when you're in {settlement}. You inspire us.

hostile: Halt. You have ten seconds to leave {settlement}. I suggest you use them.
I will not warn you again. Leave. Now.
cold: Halt. State your business. And make it convincing.
I know your type. Keep your hands where I can see them.
guarded: Halt. State your business in {settlement}.
Keep your weapons sheathed while in town. Understood?
neutral: Move along, citizen. Nothing to see here.
I'm watching you, stranger. Don't try anything.
warm: You there — ah, it's you. Carry on. You've earned the right.
Good day. I know you're not here to make trouble.
affable: If more citizens were like you, my job would be much easier.
Consider yourself a friend of the watch. That carries weight here.
devoted: I'd lay down my life for this town, and for you. That's not something I say lightly.
On my honor, you will always be safe in {settlement}.

hostile: My oath compels me to give fair warning: leave, or face justice.
I take no pleasure in this, but you are not welcome here.
cold: I serve the people of {settlement}. Whether that includes you remains to be seen.
Proceed with care. My blade serves justice, not individuals.
guarded: Welcome, traveler. I am sworn to protect {settlement} and its people.
Greetings. You'll find {settlement} a safe haven, so long as I draw breath.
neutral: Well met! I stand vigil here. You have nothing to fear within these walls.
Welcome. I serve {settlement} with honor. May I assist you?
warm: A fellow warrior! Your deeds have not gone unnoticed by the watch.
Welcome, honored guest. The people of {settlement} speak well of you.
affable: You fight for what's right, same as me. We're kindred spirits, you and I.
I count you among the most honorable I've served alongside.
devoted: You have my sword, my shield, and my loyalty. For as long as I draw breath.
It is an honor to share a post with someone of your caliber.

hostile: I have nothing to say to you.
Please just leave me alone.
cold: Oh. You.
I'd rather not talk right now.
guarded: Hello, stranger. Just passing through, I hope?
Can I help you with something?
neutral: Good day!
Nice day, isn't it?
Hello there, traveler.
warm: Welcome! It's good to see friendly faces around here.
Hey! Need any help finding your way around?
affable: There's our hero! How are you today?
Oh, wonderful! You're back! The children will be thrilled!
devoted: I tell my children stories about you every night.
You saved us all. We'll never forget that.

hostile: I don't trust you. Not one bit.
People like you are the reason we lock our doors at night.
Don't expect any favors from me.
You've made enemies here. Watch your back.
*turns away with visible contempt*
The sooner you leave, the better.
I've heard what you've done. Don't think we've forgotten.
You'll find no friends here.
Some people just can't be trusted. You're proof of that.
Every eye in this place is watching you. Remember that.
cold: I don't have much to say to you.
Let's keep this brief.
I'm busy. What do you want?
Don't mistake civility for friendship.
You're tolerated here. Don't push it.
I have my reasons for keeping my distance.
We've all got our own problems. Yours aren't mine.
If you need something, ask someone else.
I'll be civil, but that's all you're getting.
Some wounds take time to heal. Just so you know.
guarded: I don't mean to be rude, but I'm cautious by nature.
Trust is earned around here, not given freely.
You seem decent enough, I suppose. Time will tell.
Nothing personal, but I keep my guard up with strangers.
The world teaches hard lessons. I've learned to be careful.
I'll give you a fair chance. That's all anyone gets.
I've seen enough travelers to know not all of them mean well.
Don't take offense if I seem distant. It's how I am.
I'm watching and listening. That's just how I operate.
Prove yourself trustworthy, and maybe we'll get along.
neutral: Life goes on, doesn't it?
Just another day around here.
Not much to report, I'm afraid.
Fair weather and fair dealings. That's all I ask.
Times are what they are.
Can't complain. Well, I could, but what's the point?
Everything's been quiet lately. Could be worse.
Just minding my own business. You should try it.
Nothing out of the ordinary to speak of.
The usual. Nothing more, nothing less.
warm: It's good to have someone reliable around.
You know, you're alright in my book.
Always glad to see a friendly face!
I was just thinking about you. Good timing!
You've done right by this place. People notice.
Between you and me, you're one of the good ones.
I feel better knowing someone like you is out there.
You've earned a lot of respect around here, you know.
If more people were like you, the world would be a better place.
It's good to know there are still decent folk in the world.
affable: My friend! Always a pleasure!
You know, I was telling everyone how lucky we are to know you.
Whenever you're in town, the mood brightens. I mean it.
If there's anything you ever need, you just say the word.
You're like family to me at this point. Truly.
I trust you more than most of my own kin, and that says something.
The town talks about you fondly, you know. With real admiration.
I've put in a good word for you everywhere I can. You deserve it.
You've changed this place for the better. Everyone feels it.
I count meeting you among the best things that's happened to me.
devoted: You are the finest person I've ever had the honor of knowing.
I would do anything for you. You've proven yourself a hundred times over.
When I think of what a hero looks like, I think of you.
This town — this world — is better because you're in it.
There are no words for how grateful I am. You've given us hope.
I tell my grandchildren about you. They want to be just like you.
If the gods sent you to us, then I owe them a prayer of thanks every day.
You've saved more lives than you know. People don't forget that.
My loyalty to you is absolute. Whatever you need, now and always.
Some people leave a mark on the world. Yours will never fade.

innkeeper: I hear all kinds of stories behind this bar. You wouldn't believe half of them.
The trick to good ale? Patience. Same goes for running a tavern.
We had a bard in last week. Sang all night. My ears are still ringing.
Running a tavern teaches you about people. And their drinking habits.
Every traveler who walks through that door has a story. What's yours?
I keep the fire going and the spirits flowing. That's my calling.
Some nights it's dead quiet. Other nights I can barely keep up.
The road must be rough — you look like you could use a stiff drink.
I've served kings and beggars alike. This bar doesn't discriminate.
If these walls could talk, they'd tell tales that would curl your hair.
patron: I've been sitting here since midday. The ale's that good.
You ever wonder what's out there, beyond the horizon?
I came in for one drink. That was three hours ago.
Back in my day, we didn't need adventurers. We handled things ourselves.
Best part of this tavern? The company. Well, most of it.
I'm waiting for someone. They were supposed to be here an hour ago.
Don't tell my wife I was here. I'm supposed to be working.
I like this spot. Good view of the door. Old habit.
There's nothing a cold ale can't fix. Well, almost nothing.
I've got a tab longer than my arm. The innkeeper's a saint for putting up with me.
merchant: Supply and demand, my friend. That's the secret of commerce.
I've traveled to three kingdoms to stock these shelves.
Every item here has a story. Some of them even end happily.
Business has been up since the trouble started. People buy when they're scared.
I price fairly. That's why I'm still in business after twenty years.
You'd be surprised what you can learn from trade caravans. All sorts of news.
The roads have gotten dangerous. Shipping costs are through the roof.
A good merchant knows the value of everything and the cost of nothing.
Inventory day is tomorrow. Don't remind me. *sighs*
I imported some rare goods from the south. Interested?
blacksmith: The clang of hammer on steel — that's my music.
I've been smithing since I was tall enough to reach the anvil.
Good steel speaks to you if you know how to listen.
Every weapon I forge, I think about who'll use it and why.
The fire never goes out in this forge. Not while I'm alive.
I made a blade last week that could split a hair. My finest work yet.
A weapon is only as good as the hand that wields it. Remember that.
I'm always looking for better ore. The local stuff is... adequate.
Repairs are half my business. Adventurers break everything.
The forge teaches patience. And what happens when you lack it.
leader: The weight of leadership is heavier than any crown.
My duty is to these people. Everything else comes second.
Every decision I make affects hundreds of lives. I don't take that lightly.
Trade, defense, morale — a settlement's needs never end.
I've served this settlement for many years. I plan to serve for many more.
Diplomacy is harder than fighting. Trust me.
The safety of my people is my highest priority.
I receive reports from scouts regularly. The wilderness holds many dangers.
Leadership isn't about giving orders. It's about earning trust.
My door is always open to those who serve this community.
guard: Long hours, low pay. But someone's got to do it.
I've seen things on night watch that would make you think twice about the dark.
The walls keep most threats out. Most, but not all.
I rotate between the gate and the market. Both need watching.
If trouble comes, I'll be the first to meet it. That's what I signed up for.
I do drills every morning. You don't survive combat without discipline.
Keep your wits about you after dark. The shadows hide more than you'd think.
I've been on the guard for seven years. Wouldn't trade it for anything.
We had an incident last week. Handled it, but it was close.
The captain says we need more recruits. Not many volunteer these days.
citizen: I'm just a regular person trying to get by.
The harvest should be good this year. Or so the farmers say.
My kids keep asking when the next festival is. They never stop.
Been meaning to fix that roof for months. Never seem to find the time.
I work the fields most days. Hard work, honest living.
My neighbor thinks he saw something in the woods. Probably just a deer.
The price of bread has gone up again. When will it end?
I heard the merchant got a shipment of exotic spices. Fancy stuff.
Life here isn't exciting, but it's peaceful. Mostly.
I worry about my family, with all the trouble in the world.

friendly: You look like you could use a warm meal. Have you eaten?
I always try to see the best in people. Haven't been disappointed yet!
If you ever need anything, just ask. That's what neighbors are for.
A smile costs nothing but is worth everything, don't you think?
I love meeting new people. Everyone has something interesting to share.
Life's too short for grudges. Better to make friends, I say.
Tell me about your travels! I love a good story.
You seem like good people. I can always tell.
Need directions? Help carrying something? I'm happy to lend a hand.
We should look out for each other. That's how communities survive.
grumpy: What now? Can't a person get a moment's peace?
Things were better in the old days. Everything's gone downhill.
Don't expect me to be cheerful. I've seen too much for that.
Bah. Another problem to deal with.
I'm not in the mood for small talk. I'm never in the mood.
People keep bothering me with their problems. Do I look like I care?
The weather's terrible, the food's worse, and the company... *gestures at you*
I've been through harder times than this. Doesn't mean I have to enjoy it.
Save the pleasantries. Let's just get through the day.
Everyone's always so happy. Makes me suspicious.
jovial: Ha ha! What a fine day to be alive!
I've got a joke for you — no? Fine, I'll tell it anyway!
The secret to a good life? Laugh as much as possible!
Everything's funnier with a drink in hand. Trust me on that.
Life's a grand adventure! Why so serious?
I once arm-wrestled a bear. Well, it was a very small bear.
They say laughter is the best medicine. I must be the healthiest person alive!
Every problem has a funny side. You just have to squint a bit.
Come on, crack a smile! The world isn't ending. Well, probably not.
Who needs gold when you've got good friends and better stories?
mysterious: There are things in this world that defy explanation...
The stars have been restless lately. I wonder why.
Not everything is as it appears. Remember that.
I sense something about you... but I can't quite place it.
The old ways still hold power, if you know where to look.
Some secrets are better left buried. Others demand to be found.
I've seen signs and portents. Change is coming.
The veil between worlds grows thin in places like these.
Trust your dreams. They speak truths your waking mind refuses.
Fate has a way of bringing the right people together.
nervous: Did you hear that? Probably nothing. Probably.
I worry about everything. It's a talent, really.
Is it just me, or does something feel... off today?
I keep checking over my shoulder. Old habit, I suppose.
What if something happens? I mean, it probably won't, but what if?
I've been sleeping poorly. Bad dreams, you know?
Sorry, I'm a bit on edge. It's been a strange week.
Do you think we're safe here? Really safe?
I jump at shadows these days. Can you blame me?
